Map of West and North Africa showing the trans-Saharan trade routes. Thick lines connecting Tripoli and Tunis in the north to Kano and Ngazargamu (Borno) in the south. Icons of camels on the routes, salt bars in the desert, and gold/kola nuts in the savanna. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Illustration of a trans-Saharan caravan. In the foreground, a Tuareg man on a camel, his face wrapped in a blue indigo veil (tagelmust) with only his eyes showing, holding a spear and guiding the caravan. Behind him, a long line of heavily loaded camels walking across sandy dunes. The bright sun beats down. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Map of the Triangular Trade spanning the Atlantic Ocean. Arrow 1 (blue) from Europe to West Africa. Arrow 2 (red) from West Africa to the Americas (Caribbean/Brazil/North America). Arrow 3 (green) from the Americas back to Europe. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
